name: hexagon-pattern
title: Hexagon Pattern
description: An SVG honeycomb backdrop: faint outlined hexagons tile the whole area and fade at the edges, with a handful of cells filled in to draw the eye where you place them.
use: A dark section wants a geometric, technical texture with a few accent cells.
avoid: Behind dense content: the faint pattern adds noise without carrying meaning.
a11y: Decorative and aria-hidden, so assistive tech ignores it; nothing here needs operating. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark honeycomb of flat-top hexagons drawn in faint grey outlines, tiled across the stage and fading out at the edges. A dozen cells are filled with a soft grey wash, scattered unevenly.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. The filled cells are fixed by the coordinate list passed in, not by hover or time.
customise: Cell radius, gap, offsets, orientation, dash style and a list of cells to fill are props; the stroke colour comes from classes.
weight: light: One tiled SVG pattern and a few polygons; no script or animation.
polishWhy: Even honeycomb and a tasteful scatter of lit cells; the pattern stays very faint overall.
